quoteBreaks.leftText: Normalising the unnatural, rupturing the way of the world.
quoteBreaks.rightText: Art is a language that goes beyond words, tells our stories, involves a relationship between artist, artwork and audience. And spread like the plaque leaving nothing pure. Incapable of a conscience, they kill needlessly and create havoc.
quoteBreaks.rightTextFootnote: What begins as expression can sometimes turn into distortion.
